node.title: Re: Remove SOME new lines
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [RenMcCourtey],

Is this what you're looking for?

$ cat in.txt AaX ObU UcU XdR ZeZ UfH UgU FhA OiG UjX UkZ UlZ xmT $ perl -pe 'chomp if /^U/' in.txt AaX ObU UcUXdR ZeZ UfHUgUFhA OiG UjXUkZUlZxmT

Update: Explanation: When using the -p switch without the -l switch ([doc://perlrun]), each line read into $_ still contains the newline, which is normally output when the lines are [doc://print]ed back out. So the [doc://chomp] just chops the newline off, and those lines are printed without the final newline.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
